portraits.prompt: Conservative identity-preserving enhancement of the supplied Little Beans cat roster: improve sharpness and reduce blur in all 17 photo circles; preserve cats, markings, collars, poses, labels and original layout; no substituted cats. Built-in image generation edit. The generated output rearranged the poster spacing; the app uses dedicated portrait coordinates and labels the result AI-enhanced. Fine details are inferred, not recovered original photographic data.
portraits.limitations: AI reconstruction can infer or alter details; original images remain available in the cat selector. No sharper verified original images of these residents were found in the public-source search.
